-- 黑龙鞍座：靠近触发、上下座按钮、骑手对齐与离座恢复
---@displayName 黑龙鞍座
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local runtimeScope = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local interactionButton = nil
local localActorId = nil
local hasLocalPassenger = false
local localActor = nil

local seatedActors = {}
local savedScale = {}
local savedPosition = {}
local savedRotation = {}
local savedColliderEnabled = {}

local flightScript = nil

local function getFlightScript()
  if flightScript ~= nil then return flightScript end
  if runtimeScope == nil then return nil end
  flightScript = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-flight.lua")
  return flightScript
end

local function notifyFlight(active)
  local flight = getFlightScript()
  if flight == nil or type(flight.SetRiderActive) ~= "function" then return end
  flight.SetRiderActive(active)
end

local function notifyOccupied(value)
  local flight = getFlightScript()
  if flight == nil or type(flight.SetOccupied) ~= "function" then return end
  flight.SetOccupied(value)
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then return end
  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(
    typeof(CS.UnityEngine.UI.Text), true)
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function ensureInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton == nil then
    interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  end
  setButtonText(hasLocalPassenger and "站起" or "坐下")
end

local function removeInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
    interactionButton = nil
  end
end

local function resolveSeatTrans()
  return self.transform
end

local function alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  target = target or resolveSeatTrans()
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil or target == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(target)
  trans.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  trans.localRotation = UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity

  local original = savedScale[actor] or UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  local parentScale = target.lossyScale
  trans.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    original.x / (parentScale.x ~= 0 and parentScale.x or 1),
    original.y / (parentScale.y ~= 0 and parentScale.y or 1),
    original.z / (parentScale.z ~= 0 and parentScale.z or 1)
  )

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(
    typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator == nil then return end

  local hips = animator:GetBoneTransform(CS.UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  if hips == nil then return end

  local hipsPosition = hips.position
  local actorPosition = trans.position
  trans.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    actorPosition.x - (hipsPosition.x - actorPosition.x),
    actorPosition.y - (hipsPosition.y - actorPosition.y),
    actorPosition.z - (hipsPosition.z - actorPosition.z)
  )
end

local function setActorColliderEnabled(actor, enabled)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local collider = actor.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Collider))
  if collider == nil then return end

  if not enabled then
    savedColliderEnabled[actor] = collider.enabled
    collider.enabled = false
  else
    local previous = savedColliderEnabled[actor]
    collider.enabled = previous == nil or previous
    savedColliderEnabled[actor] = nil
  end
end

local function placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(nil)

  if savedScale[actor] ~= nil then
    trans.localScale = savedScale[actor]
    savedScale[actor] = nil
  end

  local savedPos = savedPosition[actor]
  local savedRot = savedRotation[actor]
  if savedPos ~= nil and savedRot ~= nil then
    actor.position = savedPos
    actor.rotation = savedRot
  else
    local right = self.transform.right
    local base = self.transform.position
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      base.x + right.x * 1.2,
      base.y,
      base.z + right.z * 1.2
    )
    actor.rotation = self.transform.rotation
  end

  savedPosition[actor] = nil
  savedRotation[actor] = nil
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  localActorId = actor.actorID
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end

  -- 在座时保留 Actor ID 和交互通道，保证飞行中仍能站起。
  if not hasLocalPassenger then
    self:DisableInteraction()
    localActorId = nil
  end
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  ensureInteractionButton()
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActorId == nil then return end

  local actor = DouyinActorService.GetActorById(localActorId)
  if actor == nil then return end

  if hasLocalPassenger then
    actor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
  else
    if actor:IsFlying() or resolveSeatTrans() == nil then return end
    actor:SitDown(self.gameObject, true)
  end
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  local target = resolveSeatTrans()
  if target == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  savedPosition[actor] = trans.position
  savedRotation[actor] = trans.rotation
  savedScale[actor] = trans.localScale

  alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  seatedActors[actor] = target
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, false)
  notifyOccupied(true)

  if actor.isLocal then
    hasLocalPassenger = true
    localActor = actor
    if actor.Immobilize ~= nil then
      actor:Immobilize(true)
    end
    self:EnableInteraction()
    ensureInteractionButton()
    notifyFlight(true)
  end
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end

  -- 先停止持续对齐，再解除挂载，避免离座后又被拉回座位。
  seatedActors[actor] = nil
  if actor.gameObject == nil then
    notifyOccupied(false)
    if actor.isLocal then
      hasLocalPassenger = false
      localActor = nil
      notifyFlight(false)
    end
    return
  end
  placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
  notifyOccupied(false)

  if actor.isLocal then
    hasLocalPassenger = false
    if localActor == actor then
      localActor = nil
    end
    if actor.Immobilize ~= nil then
      actor:Immobilize(false)
    end
    setButtonText("坐下")
    notifyFlight(false)
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  for actor, target in pairs(seatedActors) do
    alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  end
end

local function cleanupLocalRider()
  if localActor ~= nil and localActor.Immobilize ~= nil then
    localActor:Immobilize(false)
  end
  localActor = nil
  hasLocalPassenger = false
  seatedActors = {}
  notifyOccupied(false)
  notifyFlight(false)
end

function OnDisable()
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnDestroy()
  removeInteractionButton()
  cleanupLocalRider()
end

-- 黑龙飞行驱动与翅膀挥动表现
---@displayName 黑龙飞行控制
---@start
---@var HorizontalSpeed:number=9
---@name 水平飞行速度
---@desc 按住前进或后退时的最高飞行速度
---@group 飞行
---@var VerticalSpeed:number=5

---@group 表现
---@var IdleFlapSpeed:number=0.55
---@name 待机扇翅频率
---@desc 未被骑乘时每秒轻扇翅膀的次数

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Vector2 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector2
local Vector3 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3
local Quaternion = CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion
local Mathf = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local Input = CS.UnityEngine.Input
local KeyCode = CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode
local DouyinInputService = CS.DouyinInputService
local DouyinUIService = CS.DouyinUIService
local UIType = CS.UIType
local EventTrigger = CS.UnityEngine.EventSystems.EventTrigger
local EventTriggerType = CS.UnityEngine.EventSystems.EventTriggerType
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")

local runtimeScope = RuntimeScope.from(self)

local deadZone = 0.12
local idleDamping = 4.5
local horizontalAccel = 9
local verticalAccel = 7
local pitchAngle = 18
local rollAngle = 20
local motionLerpSpeed = 5
local flightFlapAmplitude = 30
local idleFlapAmplitude = 8
local bobAmplitude = 0.035

local rb = nil
local visualRoot = nil
local wingLeft = nil
local wingRight = nil
local neckRoot = nil
local tailNodes = {}
local tailBaseX = {-10.3, -6.9, -3.4, 1.1, 8.0, 14.9, 21.8, 26.4}

local moveVec = Vector2.zero
local onMoveInputStart = nil
local onMoveInputPerform = nil
local onMoveInputCancel = nil

local riderActive = false
local occupied = false
local controlReady = false
local controlSupported = false
local controlPending = false
local nextControlTry = 0
local velocityX = 0
local velocityY = 0
local velocityZ = 0
local m_yaw = 0
local m_pitch = 0
local m_roll = 0
local animationTime = 0
local rideCameraApplied = false

local ascendBtn = nil
local ascendTrigger = nil
local descendBtn = nil
local descendTrigger = nil
local btnAscend = false
local btnDescend = false

local function clearTrigger(trigger)
  if trigger == nil then return end
  if trigger.triggers ~= nil then
    trigger.triggers:Clear()
  end
end

local function bindTrigger(btn, onDown, onUp)
  if btn == nil or btn.gameObject == nil then return nil end
  local trigger = btn.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(EventTrigger))
  if trigger == nil then
    trigger = btn.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(EventTrigger))
  end
  clearTrigger(trigger)

  local entryDown = EventTrigger.Entry()
  entryDown.eventID = EventTriggerType.PointerDown
  entryDown.callback:AddListener(function(_) onDown() end)
  trigger.triggers:Add(entryDown)

  local entryUp = EventTrigger.Entry()
  entryUp.eventID = EventTriggerType.PointerUp
  entryUp.callback:AddListener(function(_) onUp() end)
  trigger.triggers:Add(entryUp)

  return trigger
end

local function setButtonText(btn, text)
  if btn == nil then return end
  local label = btn:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.UI.Text), true)
  if label ~= nil then
    label.gameObject:SetActive(true)
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function setupActionButton(uiType, btnText, onDown, onUp)
  local btn = DouyinUIService.GetInteractionButton(uiType)
  if btn == nil then return nil, nil end
  btn.gameObject:SetActive(true)
  btn.transition = CS.UnityEngine.UI.Selectable.Transition.None
  local tween = btn.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.ButtonTweenEffect), true)
  if tween ~= nil then
    tween.enabled = false
  end
  setButtonText(btn, btnText)
  local trigger = bindTrigger(btn, onDown, onUp)
  return btn, trigger
end

local function hideButton(btn, trigger)
  if trigger ~= nil then clearTrigger(trigger) end
  if btn ~= nil then btn.gameObject:SetActive(false) end
end

local function showFlightButtons()
  if ascendBtn ~= nil or descendBtn ~= nil then return end
  ascendBtn, ascendTrigger = setupActionButton(
    UIType.CustomMain, "上升",
    function() if riderActive then btnAscend = true end end,
    function() btnAscend = false end
  )
  descendBtn, descendTrigger = setupActionButton(
    UIType.CustomSub, "下降",
    function() if riderActive then btnDescend = true end end,
    function() btnDescend = false end
  )
end

local function hideFlightButtons()
  hideButton(ascendBtn, ascendTrigger)
  ascendBtn = nil
  ascendTrigger = nil
  hideButton(descendBtn, descendTrigger)
  descendBtn = nil
  descendTrigger = nil
  btnAscend = false
  btnDescend = false
end

local function applyRideCamera()
  if rideCameraApplied then return end
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetDistance(11)
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetPitch(16)
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetOffset(Vector3(0, 1.9, 0))
  rideCameraApplied = true
end

local function restoreRideCamera()
  if not rideCameraApplied then return end
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetDistance(4)
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetPitch(0)
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetOffset(Vector3(0, 0, 0))
  rideCameraApplied = false
end

local function clearInput()
  moveVec = Vector2.zero
  btnAscend = false
  btnDescend = false
  velocityX = 0
  velocityY = 0
  velocityZ = 0
end

local function requestControl()
  if not controlSupported or controlPending or controlReady then return end
  if self:IsNull() then return end
  if self:HasControllership() then
    controlReady = true
    return
  end

  controlPending = true
  self:RequestControllership(function(success)
    controlPending = false
    if self:IsNull() then return end
    if success and self:HasControllership() then
      controlReady = true
    else
      nextControlTry = Time.time + 1.0
    end
  end)
end

local function releaseControl()
  controlReady = false
  if controlSupported and self:HasControllership() then
    self:ReleaseControllership()
  end
end

local function resolveVerticalInput()
  local up = Input.GetKey(KeyCode.E) or btnAscend
  local down = Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Q) or btnDescend
  if up and not down then return 1 end
  if down and not up then return -1 end
  return 0
end

local function findNodes()
  if runtimeScope == nil then return end
  visualRoot = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("DragonRoot/VisualRoot")
  wingLeft = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("DragonRoot/VisualRoot/WingLeftRoot")
  wingRight = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("DragonRoot/VisualRoot/WingRightRoot")
  neckRoot = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("DragonRoot/VisualRoot/NeckRoot")

  tailNodes[1] = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("DragonRoot/VisualRoot/TailRoot")
  local path = "DragonRoot/VisualRoot/TailRoot"
  for index = 1, 7 do
    path = path .. string.format("/Tail%02d", index)
    tailNodes[index + 1] = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(path)
  end
end

local function animateCreature()
  animationTime = animationTime + Time.deltaTime
  local flying = occupied
  local flapHz = flying and FlightFlapSpeed or IdleFlapSpeed
  local flapAmplitude = flying and flightFlapAmplitude or idleFlapAmplitude
  local flap = Mathf.Sin(animationTime * flapHz * 2 * Mathf.PI) * flapAmplitude

  -- Unity 的 X 轴相对 glTF 镜像：左翼位于 -X，需要反向 Z 旋转抬翼。
  if wingLeft ~= nil then
    wingLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(0, 0, -flap)
  end
  if wingRight ~= nil then
    wingRight.localEulerAngles = Vector3(0, 0, flap)
  end

  local swayAmplitude = flying and 5.0 or 2.5
  for index = 1, #tailNodes do
    local node = tailNodes[index]
    if node ~= nil then
      local sway = Mathf.Sin(animationTime * 1.25 - index * 0.42) * swayAmplitude
      node.localEulerAngles = Vector3(tailBaseX[index], sway, 0)
    end
  end

  if neckRoot ~= nil then
    local neckBob = Mathf.Sin(animationTime * 0.85) * 1.2
    neckRoot.localEulerAngles = Vector3(neckBob, 0, 0)
  end

  if visualRoot ~= nil then
    local bob = 0
    if flying then
      bob = Mathf.Sin(animationTime * 2.1) * bobAmplitude
    end
    visualRoot.localPosition = Vector3(0, bob, 0)
  end
end

function Start()
  rb = self.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
  controlSupported = self.HasControllership ~= nil and self.RequestControllership ~= nil
  findNodes()

  onMoveInputStart = function()
    -- 起手时保持当前方向，由 Perform 覆盖。
  end
  onMoveInputPerform = function(vec)
    moveVec = vec
  end
  onMoveInputCancel = function()
    moveVec = Vector2.zero
  end

  DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:AddListener(onMoveInputStart)
  DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:AddListener(onMoveInputPerform)
  DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:AddListener(onMoveInputCancel)
end

function SetOccupied(value)
  occupied = value == true
end

function SetRiderActive(active)
  if active then
    if riderActive then return end
    riderActive = true
    occupied = true
    velocityX = 0
    velocityY = 0
    velocityZ = 0
    m_pitch = 0
    m_roll = 0
    m_yaw = self.transform.eulerAngles.y
    controlReady = not controlSupported
    nextControlTry = 0
    applyRideCamera()
    showFlightButtons()
    if controlSupported then
      requestControl()
    end
  else
    if not riderActive then return end
    riderActive = false
    occupied = false
    clearInput()
    m_pitch = 0
    m_roll = 0
    hideFlightButtons()
    restoreRideCamera()
    releaseControl()
  end
end

function OnControllershipTransferred(prevPlayer, currentPlayer)
  if not controlSupported then return end
  controlReady = self:HasControllership()
  if not controlReady and riderActive then
    nextControlTry = Time.time + 1.0
  end
end

function Update()
  animateCreature()

  if riderActive and controlSupported and not controlReady and not controlPending
    and Time.time >= nextControlTry then
    requestControl()
  end
end

function FixedUpdate()
  if not riderActive or not controlReady or rb == nil then return end

  local dt = Time.fixedDeltaTime
  local forwardInput = moveVec.y
  local turnInput = moveVec.x
  if math.abs(forwardInput) < deadZone then forwardInput = 0 end
  if math.abs(turnInput) < deadZone then turnInput = 0 end
  local verticalInput = resolveVerticalInput()

  m_yaw = m_yaw + turnInput * TurnSpeed * dt
  local targetPitch = -verticalInput * pitchAngle
  local targetRoll = -turnInput * rollAngle
  local lerpT = Mathf.Clamp01(motionLerpSpeed * dt)
  m_pitch = Mathf.Lerp(m_pitch, targetPitch, lerpT)
  m_roll = Mathf.Lerp(m_roll, targetRoll, lerpT)
  rb:MoveRotation(Quaternion.Euler(m_pitch, m_yaw, m_roll))

  local forward = self.transform.forward
  local horizontalForward = Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
  if horizontalForward.sqrMagnitude <= 0.0001 then
    horizontalForward = Vector3(0, 0, 1)
  else
    horizontalForward:Normalize()
  end

  local targetX = horizontalForward.x * forwardInput * HorizontalSpeed
  local targetZ = horizontalForward.z * forwardInput * HorizontalSpeed
  local targetY = verticalInput * VerticalSpeed
  local horizontalStep = (forwardInput == 0 and idleDamping or horizontalAccel) * dt
  local verticalStep = (verticalInput == 0 and idleDamping or verticalAccel) * dt

  velocityX = Mathf.MoveTowards(velocityX, targetX, horizontalStep)
  velocityZ = Mathf.MoveTowards(velocityZ, targetZ, horizontalStep)
  velocityY = Mathf.MoveTowards(velocityY, targetY, verticalStep)

  local nextPosition = rb.position + Vector3(velocityX, velocityY, velocityZ) * dt
  rb:MovePosition(nextPosition)
end

function OnDisable()
  if riderActive then
    riderActive = false
    clearInput()
    hideFlightButtons()
    restoreRideCamera()
    releaseControl()
  end
end

function OnDestroy()
  if onMoveInputStart ~= nil then
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:RemoveListener(onMoveInputStart)
    onMoveInputStart = nil
  end
  if onMoveInputPerform ~= nil then
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:RemoveListener(onMoveInputPerform)
    onMoveInputPerform = nil
  end
  if onMoveInputCancel ~= nil then
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:RemoveListener(onMoveInputCancel)
    onMoveInputCancel = nil
  end
  hideFlightButtons()
  restoreRideCamera()
  releaseControl()
end

Review findings:

1. `local Input = CS.UnityEngine.Input` — in Unity, `Input.GetKey` is a static method; calling `Input.GetKey(KeyCode.E)` works in Lua. But `Input` is also a reserved? No.

2. `Mathf.PI` exists? In Unity, `Mathf.PI` is a static constant. Access in XLua should work. Yes.

3. `Vector3(0,0,1)` calls Unity Vector3 constructor. Good.

4. In `animateCreature`, `wingLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(0, 0, -flap)`. But the initial wing node has rotation 0; fine. However, the wing membrane/bones are children of `WingLeftDisplay` which is a child of `WingLeftRoot`. Rotating WingLeftRoot around Z rotates the whole wing. Good.

5. The tail nodes: `tailBaseX` is indexed 1..8. `tailNodes` gets 8 entries. Good.

6. `SetOccupied` is called from pi-seat, but ms-flight's Start must have run. It has.

7. `OnSeatEntered` local calls `notifyOccupied(true)` and then `notifyFlight(true)`. `SetRiderActive` returns early if `riderActive` already true. On a re-seat after exiting, riderActive false. Good.

8. If a remote actor sits while the local player is not seated, `occupied=true`, fast flap, no buttons/camera. Good.

9. If a remote actor sits while the local player IS seated — impossible (one seat).

10. If the local player exits, `notifyOccupied(false)` then `notifyFlight(false)`; `SetRiderActive(false)` sets occupied=false. Good.

11. `showFlightButtons` uses `CustomMain` and `CustomSub`. Good. But the "stand up" button is an interactor button; the ascend/descend buttons are action buttons. Both can coexist. Good.

12. Camera: `CS.DouyinCameraService` may be nil in single-player? The docs use it. Fine.

13. Control request: `self.HasControllership ~= nil` — in Lua, indexing a userdata for a missing method may return nil. Good. But if the property access is a C# method that requires a `self` and is invoked with `.`? We're not invoking, just reading. Fine.

14. `self:IsNull()` — okay.

15. `requestControl` retry: if `nextControlTry` starts at 0, the first call happens immediately in SetRiderActive. If Request fails and sets nextControlTry, Update retries every second. Good.

16. If the local player mounts while the network isn't settled, RequestControllership may fail (callback false) and retry. Good.

17. Movement uses the root's Rigidbody. The root is kinematic and collider disabled. Good.

18. `rb.position` is the physics position. MovePosition moves. Good.

19. If `rb` is nil, FixedUpdate returns; the dragon won't move but wings still flap. Fine.

20. The seat alignment uses `actor.gameObject.transform`; the actor root may have an Animator in children. Good.

21. `placeActorAtStandPoint` uses `actor.position = savedPos`. The docs say use actor position API; a property assignment is the documented pattern. Good.

22. `setActorColliderEnabled` uses `GetComponent(typeof(Collider))` on the actor root; if the collider is a CharacterController (which is not a Collider? CharacterController inherits Collider in Unity). Yes, CharacterController extends Collider. Good.

23. `savedColliderEnabled` saves the current enabled state. Good.

24. `setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)` in OnSeatExited after `actor.gameObject` non-nil. Good.

25. `OnDisable` in pi-seat removes the button but doesn't disable interaction. The platform may handle. Fine.

26. `cleanupLocalRider` sets `seatedActors = {}` but doesn't detach actors. OnDestroy, the game object is destroyed; actors may be stuck parented. This is a corner case. The platform likely cleans up the seat on destroy. Fine.

27. In `pi-seat`, `resolveSeatTrans` returns self.transform, never nil. The check is harmless.

28. In `OnInteractorButtonClick`, `actor:IsFlying()` might be true if the player is flying (native flight). Reject. Good.

29. `TriggerRangeScale` applied at top-level. Good.

30. The trigger box and interaction are on the SeatAnchor. Good.

Now, one important issue: The `---@var TriggerRangeScale` trigger range scaling is applied to the trigger on the same object. Good.

Another concern: The action buttons `CustomMain`/`CustomSub` are global; the "上升/下降" buttons show even when the player isn't the controller (rare). Fine.

Now, the camera default restore values may not match the actual default. Could we cache the camera values before applying instead? There may be `DouyinCameraService.GetDistance`? The doc says "不假设 GetDistance 存在，自己缓存" and then provides default constants. Hmm, "自己缓存" could mean store defaults in locals as they did. So okay.

Now, what about the player's `Immobilize` state when the module is destroyed while seated? `cleanupLocalRider` calls Immobilize(false). Good.

Now, one more significant thing: The player's seated alignment and the visual bob. The seat script's LateUpdate aligns the actor's Hips to the seat anchor. The seat anchor moves with the visual bob (which happens in ms-flight.Update, before LateUpdate). Good.

Now, the camera is set once on mount; it follows the player automatically. Good.

Now, the flight is controlled by move input (joystick/WASD) and E/Q. On mobile, the ascend/descend buttons. Good.

Now, does the player need to press a "fly" button? No; once mounted, movement immediately flies (horizontal movement makes it glide; E rises). The dragon is already a flying creature. Good.

Now, "可以飞" might imply automatic wing flapping while moving; yes.

Now, check that the model's wings are large enough and visible from the saddle. The saddle is at y 2.05, wings rise to 3.3 on both sides. Good.

Now, the model is 4.32m wide; the camera distance 11 shows it.

Now, one risk: The camera offset (0,1.9,0) plus distance 11 may be too far/high, but okay.

Now, should the dragon have a nameplate or UI? Not requested. No Runtime UI.

Now, final answer. But first, update the todo list. Also maybe mention the intentional choice of geometry route. And the collision note.

Let's ensure no Mix archive needed. The instructions say "只要当前任务需要多资源交互，或是需要对关卡进行摆放布置，就必须进入玩法生成链路，最终需要生成 mix 包". This is a single Module, no multi-resource interaction, no placement. So no Mix. Good.

Now, the user might expect the dragon to be placed in the world; but they asked "生成一个...龙" — a Module resource. The task type is resource generation. The module is archived and available. Good.

Now, final response in Chinese. Keep it concise but informative:
- 已生成并归档 `module-black-dragon`（玄甲黑龙坐骑）。
- 外观: 黑色鳞甲、腹部分节甲片、黄眼竖瞳、后掠角、翼膜扇贝边缘、刃状尾尖、背部小鞍座；静态为蹲坐抬翼姿势。
- 交互: 靠近出现"坐下"；坐下后摇杆前后飞/左右转，E/Q 或右下角"上升/下降"；"站起"离座。翅膀待机轻扇，飞行时大幅快速扇动；尾巴摆动、身体轻微起伏。
- 技术: 几何模型（为了双翼/尾节独立运动），鞍座锚点1:1缩放，骑手挂载与Hips对齐；相机上座拉远、离座恢复；Root刚体运动同步。
- 注意: 为保证飞行稳定，龙身不做实体碰撞（触发区负责靠近交互）；如需实体阻挡可以再加碰撞代理。
- Not created: no Runtime UI, no level placement, no Mix.

Should I mention "没有生成 Mix/关卡摆放"? Yes, as a note that this is a single module.

Do not mention internal tool names or hidden config. The resource ID is fine.

Also note the template: We didn't use a generator template because none matched. Not necessary to tell the user. The final answer should focus on the result. But the system says "返回时简短说明使用的模板和实际适配" for subagents; we're the parent doing a single module. It says Module / Runtime UI subtasks should report template usage. We're the main task. Not required in the user-facing final, but could mention "采用自定义载具/座位接入，因为现有刚体模板不适用于非骨骼翼龙". Probably too technical. Keep it light.

已完成并归档模组 `module-black-dragon`（玄甲黑龙坐骑）。

**外观**
- 黑色西方龙，蹲坐抬翼姿势，长颈、四足、长尾
- 腹部有分节甲片，琥珀色竖瞳，后掠双角，翼膜后缘带扇贝缺口，尾端为骨刃
- 背部有小型皮鞍，作为骑乘位置

**玩法**
- 玩家靠近后出现“坐下”，点击即可骑上龙背
- 骑乘后摇杆前后飞行、左右转向；按 E / Q 或右下角“上升 / 下降”按钮控制高度
- 点击“站起”离座，人物回到上龙前的位置
- 待机时双翼轻扇；被骑乘和飞行时扇动幅度与频率提高，尾巴持续摆动，飞行中身体有轻微起伏
- 上座时相机自动拉远，离座后恢复默认视角

**实现说明**
- 采用几何模型路线，双翼、尾节、颈部是独立节点，才能实现挥翅和尾部摆动
- 鞍座锚点保持 1:1 缩放，避免骑手被鞍座拉伸；骑手使用 Hips 持续对齐
- 根节点开启运动同步，飞行由本地骑手取得控制权后驱动
- 为保证飞行稳定，龙身没有启用实体碰撞，靠近交互由鞍座触发区负责；如果后续需要玩家被龙身挡住，可以再加碰撞代理

当前只交付了这一个可骑乘模组，没有额外生成关卡摆放、独立界面或 Mix 包。

-- 黑龙鞍座：靠近触发、上下座按钮、骑手对齐与离座恢复
---@displayName 黑龙鞍座
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local runtimeScope = RuntimeScope.from(self)
local TriggerRangeScaleApplied = Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local interactionButton = nil
local localActorId = nil
local hasLocalPassenger = false
local localActor = nil

local seatedActors = {}
local savedScale = {}
local savedPosition = {}
local savedRotation = {}
local savedColliderEnabled = {}

local flightScript = nil

local function getFlightScript()
  if flightScript ~= nil then return flightScript end
  if runtimeScope == nil then return nil end
  flightScript = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-flight.lua")
  return flightScript
end

local function notifyFlight(active)
  local flight = getFlightScript()
  if flight == nil or type(flight.SetRiderActive) ~= "function" then return end
  flight.SetRiderActive(active)
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then return end
  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(
    typeof(CS.UnityEngine.UI.Text), true)
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function ensureInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton == nil then
    interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  end
  setButtonText(hasLocalPassenger and "站起" or "坐下")
end

local function removeInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
    interactionButton = nil
  end
end

local function resolveSeatTrans()
  return self.transform
end

local function alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  target = target or resolveSeatTrans()
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil or target == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(target)
  trans.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  trans.localRotation = UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity

  local original = savedScale[actor] or UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  local parentScale = target.lossyScale
  trans.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    original.x / (parentScale.x ~= 0 and parentScale.x or 1),
    original.y / (parentScale.y ~= 0 and parentScale.y or 1),
    original.z / (parentScale.z ~= 0 and parentScale.z or 1)
  )

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(
    typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator == nil then return end

  local hips = animator:GetBoneTransform(CS.UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  if hips == nil then return end

  local hipsPosition = hips.position
  local actorPosition = trans.position
  trans.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    actorPosition.x - (hipsPosition.x - actorPosition.x),
    actorPosition.y - (hipsPosition.y - actorPosition.y),
    actorPosition.z - (hipsPosition.z - actorPosition.z)
  )
end

local function setActorColliderEnabled(actor, enabled)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local collider = actor.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Collider))
  if collider == nil then return end

  if not enabled then
    savedColliderEnabled[actor] = collider.enabled
    collider.enabled = false
  else
    local previous = savedColliderEnabled[actor]
    collider.enabled = previous == nil or previous
    savedColliderEnabled[actor] = nil
  end
end

local function placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(nil)

  if savedScale[actor] ~= nil then
    trans.localScale = savedScale[actor]
    savedScale[actor] = nil
  end

  local savedPos = savedPosition[actor]
  local savedRot = savedRotation[actor]
  if savedPos ~= nil and savedRot ~= nil then
    actor.position = savedPos
    actor.rotation = savedRot
  else
    local right = self.transform.right
    local base = self.transform.position
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      base.x + right.x * 1.2,
      base.y,
      base.z + right.z * 1.2
    )
    actor.rotation = self.transform.rotation
  end

  savedPosition[actor] = nil
  savedRotation[actor] = nil
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  localActorId = actor.actorID
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end

  -- 在座时保留 Actor ID 和交互通道，保证飞行中仍能站起。
  if not hasLocalPassenger then
    self:DisableInteraction()
    localActorId = nil
  end
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  ensureInteractionButton()
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActorId == nil then return end

  local actor = DouyinActorService.GetActorById(localActorId)
  if actor == nil then return end

  if hasLocalPassenger then
    actor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
  else
    if actor:IsFlying() or resolveSeatTrans() == nil then return end
    actor:SitDown(self.gameObject, true)
  end
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  local target = resolveSeatTrans()
  if target == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  savedPosition[actor] = trans.position
  savedRotation[actor] = trans.rotation
  savedScale[actor] = trans.localScale

  alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  seatedActors[actor] = target
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, false)

  if actor.isLocal then
    hasLocalPassenger = true
    localActor = actor
    if actor.Immobilize ~= nil then
      actor:Immobilize(true)
    end
    self:EnableInteraction()
    ensureInteractionButton()
    notifyFlight(true)
  end
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  -- 先停止持续对齐，再解除挂载，避免离座后又被拉回座位。
  seatedActors[actor] = nil
  placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)

  if actor.isLocal then
    hasLocalPassenger = false
    if localActor == actor then
      localActor = nil
    end
    if actor.Immobilize ~= nil then
      actor:Immobilize(false)
    end
    setButtonText("坐下")
    notifyFlight(false)
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  for actor, target in pairs(seatedActors) do
    alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  end
end

local function cleanupLocalRider()
  if localActor ~= nil and localActor.Immobilize ~= nil then
    localActor:Immobilize(false)
  end
  localActor = nil
  hasLocalPassenger = false
  seatedActors = {}
  notifyFlight(false)
end

function OnDisable()
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnDestroy()
  removeInteractionButton()
  cleanupLocalRider()
end

local Vector2 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector2
local Vector3 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3
local Quaternion = CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion
local Mathf = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf

local DouyinUIService = CS.DouyinUIService

local horizontalAccel = 9

local pitchAngle = 18

local visualRoot = nil
local wingLeft = nil
local wingRight = nil
local neckRoot = nil
local tailNodes = {}
local tailBaseX = {-10.3, -6.9, -3.4, 1.1, 8.0, 14.9, 21.8, 26.4}

local onMoveInputStart = nil
local onMoveInputPerform = nil
local onMoveInputCancel = nil

local riderActive = false
local controlReady = false
local controlSupported = false
local controlPending = false
local nextControlTry = 0
local velocityX = 0
local velocityY = 0
local velocityZ = 0
local m_yaw = 0
local m_pitch = 0
local m_roll = 0
local animationTime = 0

local ascendBtn = nil
local ascendTrigger = nil
local descendBtn = nil

  if not controlSupported then return end

  animateCreature()

  if riderActive and controlSupported and not controlReady and not controlPending
    and Time.time >= nextControlTry then

  end

  local targetZ = horizontalForward.z * forwardInput * HorizontalSpeed
  local targetY = verticalInput * VerticalSpeed

  local verticalStep = (verticalInput == 0 and idleDamping or verticalAccel) * dt

  velocityZ = Mathf.MoveTowards(velocityZ, targetZ, horizontalStep)
  velocityY = Mathf.MoveTowards(velocityY, targetY, verticalStep)

  rb:MovePosition(nextPosition)
end

  if riderActive then
    riderActive = false
    clearInput()
    hideFlightButtons()
    restoreRideCamera()
    releaseControl()
  end
end

  if onMoveInputStart ~= nil then

    onMoveInputStart = nil
  end

    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:RemoveListener(onMoveInputPerform)
    onMoveInputPerform = nil
  end

    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:RemoveListener(onMoveInputCancel)
    onMoveInputCancel = nil
  end
  hideFlightButtons()
  restoreRideCamera()
  releaseControl()

  if horizontalForward.sqrMagnitude <= 0.0001 then
    horizontalForward = Vector3(0, 0, 1)
  else
    horizontalForward:Normalize()
  end

  local targetX = horizontalForward.x * forwardInput * HorizontalSpeed
  local targetZ = horizontalForward.z * forwardInput * HorizontalSpeed
  local targetY = verticalInput * VerticalSpeed
  local horizontalStep = (forwardInput == 0 and idleDamping or horizontalAccel) * dt
  local verticalStep = (verticalInput == 0 and idleDamping or verticalAccel) * dt

  velocityX = Mathf.MoveTowards(velocityX, targetX, horizontalStep)
  velocityZ = Mathf.MoveTowards(velocityZ, targetZ, horizontalStep)
  velocityY = Mathf.MoveTowards(velocityY, targetY, verticalStep)

  local nextPosition = rb.position + Vector3(velocityX, velocityY, velocityZ) * dt
  rb:MovePosition(nextPosition)
end

function OnDisable()
  if riderActive then
    riderActive = false
    clearInput()
    hideFlightButtons()
    restoreRideCamera()
    releaseControl()

input.content:
-- 黑龙飞行驱动与翅膀挥动表现
---@displayName 黑龙飞行控制
---@start
---@var HorizontalSpeed:number=9
---@name 水平飞行速度
---@desc 按住前进或后退时的最高飞行速度
---@group 飞行
---@var VerticalSpeed:number=5
---@name 升降速度
---@desc 上升和下降的最高速度
---@group 飞行
---@var TurnSpeed:number=75
---@name 转向速度
---@desc 左右输入时每秒转向的角度
---@group 转向
---@var FlightFlapSpeed:number=1.9
---@name 飞行扇翅频率
---@desc 飞行时每秒扇动翅膀的次数
---@group 表现
---@var IdleFlapSpeed:number=0.55
---@name 待机扇翅频率
---@desc 未被骑乘时每秒轻扇翅膀的次数
---@group 表现
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local Vector2 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector2
local Vector3 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3
local Quaternion = CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion
local Mathf = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf
local Time = CS.UnityEngine.Time
local Input = CS.UnityEngine.Input
local KeyCode = CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode
local DouyinInputService = CS.DouyinInputService
local DouyinUIService = CS.DouyinUIService
local UIType = CS.UIType
local EventTrigger = CS.UnityEngine.EventSystems.EventTrigger
local EventTriggerType = CS.UnityEngine.EventSystems.EventTriggerType
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")

local runtimeScope = RuntimeScope.from(self)

local deadZone = 0.12
local idleDamping = 4.5
local horizontalAccel = 9
local verticalAccel = 7
local pitchAngle = 18
local rollAngle = 20
local motionLerpSpeed = 5
local flightFlapAmplitude = 30
local idleFlapAmplitude = 8
local bobAmplitude = 0.035

local rb = nil
local visualRoot = nil
local wingLeft = nil
local wingRight = nil
local neckRoot = nil
local tailNodes = {}
local tailBaseX = {-10.3, -6.9, -3.4, 1.1, 8.0, 14.9, 21.8, 26.4}

local moveVec = Vector2.zero
local onMoveInputStart = nil
local onMoveInputPerform = nil
local onMoveInputCancel = nil

local riderActive = false
local controlReady = false
local controlSupported = false
local controlPending = false
local nextControlTry = 0
local velocityX = 0
local velocityY = 0
local velocityZ = 0
local m_yaw = 0
local m_pitch = 0
local m_roll = 0
local animationTime = 0
local rideCameraApplied = false

local ascendBtn = nil
local ascendTrigger = nil
local descendBtn = nil
local descendTrigger = nil
local btnAscend = false
local btnDescend = false

local function clearTrigger(trigger)
  if trigger == nil then return end
  if trigger.triggers ~= nil then
    trigger.triggers:Clear()
  end
end

local function bindTrigger(btn, onDown, onUp)
  if btn == nil or btn.gameObject == nil then return nil end
  local trigger = btn.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(EventTrigger))
  if trigger == nil then
    trigger = btn.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(EventTrigger))
  end
  clearTrigger(trigger)

  local entryDown = EventTrigger.Entry()
  entryDown.eventID = EventTriggerType.PointerDown
  entryDown.callback:AddListener(function(_) onDown() end)
  trigger.triggers:Add(entryDown)

  local entryUp = EventTrigger.Entry()
  entryUp.eventID = EventTriggerType.PointerUp
  entryUp.callback:AddListener(function(_) onUp() end)
  trigger.triggers:Add(entryUp)

  return trigger
end

local function setButtonText(btn, text)
  if btn == nil then return end
  local label = btn:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.UI.Text), true)
  if label ~= nil then
    label.gameObject:SetActive(true)
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function setupActionButton(uiType, btnText, onDown, onUp)
  local btn = DouyinUIService.GetInteractionButton(uiType)
  if btn == nil then return nil, nil end
  btn.gameObject:SetActive(true)
  btn.transition = CS.UnityEngine.UI.Selectable.Transition.None
  local tween = btn.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.ButtonTweenEffect), true)
  if tween ~= nil then
    tween.enabled = false
  end
  setButtonText(btn, btnText)
  local trigger = bindTrigger(btn, onDown, onUp)
  return btn, trigger
end

local function hideButton(btn, trigger)
  if trigger ~= nil then clearTrigger(trigger) end
  if btn ~= nil then btn.gameObject:SetActive(false) end
end

local function showFlightButtons()
  if ascendBtn ~= nil or descendBtn ~= nil then return end
  ascendBtn, ascendTrigger = setupActionButton(
    UIType.CustomMain, "上升",
    function() if riderActive then btnAscend = true end end,
    function() btnAscend = false end
  )
  descendBtn, descendTrigger = setupActionButton(
    UIType.CustomSub, "下降",
    function() if riderActive then btnDescend = true end end,
    function() btnDescend = false end
  )
end

local function hideFlightButtons()
  hideButton(ascendBtn, ascendTrigger)
  ascendBtn = nil
  ascendTrigger = nil
  hideButton(descendBtn, descendTrigger)
  descendBtn = nil
  descendTrigger = nil
  btnAscend = false
  btnDescend = false
end

local function applyRideCamera()
  if rideCameraApplied then return end
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetDistance(11)
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetPitch(16)
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetOffset(Vector3(0, 1.9, 0))
  rideCameraApplied = true
end

local function restoreRideCamera()
  if not rideCameraApplied then return end
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetDistance(4)
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetPitch(0)
  CS.DouyinCameraService.SetOffset(Vector3(0, 0, 0))
  rideCameraApplied = false
end

local function clearInput()
  moveVec = Vector2.zero
  btnAscend = false
  btnDescend = false
  velocityX = 0
  velocityY = 0
  velocityZ = 0
end

local function requestControl()
  if not controlSupported or controlPending or controlReady then return end
  if self:IsNull() then return end
  if self:HasControllership() then
    controlReady = true
    return
  end

  controlPending = true
  self:RequestControllership(function(success)
    controlPending = false
    if self:IsNull() then return end
    if success and self:HasControllership() then
      controlReady = true
    else
      nextControlTry = Time.time + 1.0
    end
  end)
end

local function releaseControl()
  controlReady = false
  if controlSupported and self:HasControllership() then
    self:ReleaseControllership()
  end
end

local function resolveVerticalInput()
  local up = Input.GetKey(KeyCode.E) or btnAscend
  local down = Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Q) or btnDescend
  if up and not down then return 1 end
  if down and not up then return -1 end
  return 0
end

local function findNodes()
  if runtimeScope == nil then return end
  visualRoot = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("DragonRoot/VisualRoot")
  wingLeft = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("DragonRoot/VisualRoot/WingLeftRoot")
  wingRight = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("DragonRoot/VisualRoot/WingRightRoot")
  neckRoot = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("DragonRoot/VisualRoot/NeckRoot")

  tailNodes[1] = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath("DragonRoot/VisualRoot/TailRoot")
  local path = "DragonRoot/VisualRoot/TailRoot"
  for index = 1, 7 do
    path = path .. string.format("/Tail%02d", index)
    tailNodes[index + 1] = runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(path)
  end
end

local function animateCreature()
  animationTime = animationTime + Time.deltaTime
  local flying = riderActive and controlReady
  local flapHz = flying and FlightFlapSpeed or IdleFlapSpeed
  local flapAmplitude = flying and flightFlapAmplitude or idleFlapAmplitude
  local flap = Mathf.Sin(animationTime * flapHz * 2 * Mathf.PI) * flapAmplitude

  -- Unity 的 X 轴相对 glTF 镜像：左翼位于 -X，需要反向 Z 旋转抬翼。
  if wingLeft ~= nil then
    wingLeft.localEulerAngles = Vector3(0, 0, -flap)
  end
  if wingRight ~= nil then
    wingRight.localEulerAngles = Vector3(0, 0, flap)
  end

  local swayAmplitude = flying and 5.0 or 2.5
  for index = 1, #tailNodes do
    local node = tailNodes[index]
    if node ~= nil then
      local sway = Mathf.Sin(animationTime * 1.25 - index * 0.42) * swayAmplitude
      node.localEulerAngles = Vector3(tailBaseX[index], sway, 0)
    end
  end

  if neckRoot ~= nil then
    local neckBob = Mathf.Sin(animationTime * 0.85) * 1.2
    neckRoot.localEulerAngles = Vector3(neckBob, 0, 0)
  end

  if visualRoot ~= nil then
    local bob = 0
    if flying then
      bob = Mathf.Sin(animationTime * 2.1) * bobAmplitude
    end
    visualRoot.localPosition = Vector3(0, bob, 0)
  end
end

function Start()
  rb = self.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(UnityEngine.Rigidbody))
  controlSupported = self.HasControllership ~= nil and self.RequestControllership ~= nil
  findNodes()

  onMoveInputStart = function()
    -- 起手时保持当前方向，由 Perform 覆盖。
  end
  onMoveInputPerform = function(vec)
    moveVec = vec
  end
  onMoveInputCancel = function()
    moveVec = Vector2.zero
  end

  DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:AddListener(onMoveInputStart)
  DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:AddListener(onMoveInputPerform)
  DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:AddListener(onMoveInputCancel)
end

function SetRiderActive(active)
  if active then
    if riderActive then return end
    riderActive = true
    velocityX = 0
    velocityY = 0
    velocityZ = 0
    m_pitch = 0
    m_roll = 0
    m_yaw = self.transform.eulerAngles.y
    controlReady = not controlSupported
    nextControlTry = 0
    applyRideCamera()
    showFlightButtons()
    if controlSupported then
      requestControl()
    end
  else
    if not riderActive then return end
    riderActive = false
    clearInput()
    m_pitch = 0
    m_roll = 0
    hideFlightButtons()
    restoreRideCamera()
    releaseControl()
  end
end

function OnControllershipTransferred(prevPlayer, currentPlayer)
  if not controlSupported then return end
  controlReady = self:HasControllership()
  if not controlReady and riderActive then
    nextControlTry = Time.time + 1.0
  end
end

function Update()
  animateCreature()

  if riderActive and controlSupported and not controlReady and not controlPending
    and Time.time >= nextControlTry then
    requestControl()
  end
end

function FixedUpdate()
  if not riderActive or not controlReady or rb == nil then return end

  local dt = Time.fixedDeltaTime
  local forwardInput = moveVec.y
  local turnInput = moveVec.x
  if math.abs(forwardInput) < deadZone then forwardInput = 0 end
  if math.abs(turnInput) < deadZone then turnInput = 0 end
  local verticalInput = resolveVerticalInput()

  m_yaw = m_yaw + turnInput * TurnSpeed * dt
  local targetPitch = -verticalInput * pitchAngle
  local targetRoll = -turnInput * rollAngle
  local lerpT = Mathf.Clamp01(motionLerpSpeed * dt)
  m_pitch = Mathf.Lerp(m_pitch, targetPitch, lerpT)
  m_roll = Mathf.Lerp(m_roll, targetRoll, lerpT)
  rb:MoveRotation(Quaternion.Euler(m_pitch, m_yaw, m_roll))

  local forward = self.transform.forward
  local horizontalForward = Vector3(forward.x, 0, forward.z)
  if horizontalForward.sqrMagnitude <= 0.0001 then
    horizontalForward = Vector3(0, 0, 1)
  else
    horizontalForward:Normalize()
  end

  local targetX = horizontalForward.x * forwardInput * HorizontalSpeed
  local targetZ = horizontalForward.z * forwardInput * HorizontalSpeed
  local targetY = verticalInput * VerticalSpeed
  local horizontalStep = (forwardInput == 0 and idleDamping or horizontalAccel) * dt
  local verticalStep = (verticalInput == 0 and idleDamping or verticalAccel) * dt

  velocityX = Mathf.MoveTowards(velocityX, targetX, horizontalStep)
  velocityZ = Mathf.MoveTowards(velocityZ, targetZ, horizontalStep)
  velocityY = Mathf.MoveTowards(velocityY, targetY, verticalStep)

  local nextPosition = rb.position + Vector3(velocityX, velocityY, velocityZ) * dt
  rb:MovePosition(nextPosition)
end

function OnDisable()
  if riderActive then
    riderActive = false
    clearInput()
    hideFlightButtons()
    restoreRideCamera()
    releaseControl()
  end
end

function OnDestroy()
  if onMoveInputStart ~= nil then
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputStart:RemoveListener(onMoveInputStart)
    onMoveInputStart = nil
  end
  if onMoveInputPerform ~= nil then
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputPerform:RemoveListener(onMoveInputPerform)
    onMoveInputPerform = nil
  end
  if onMoveInputCancel ~= nil then
    DouyinInputService.onMoveInputCancel:RemoveListener(onMoveInputCancel)
    onMoveInputCancel = nil
  end
  hideFlightButtons()
  restoreRideCamera()
  releaseControl()
end

---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local interactionButton = nil
local localActorId = nil

display.text:
-- 黑龙鞍座：靠近触发、上下座按钮、骑手对齐与离座恢复
---@displayName 黑龙鞍座
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local runtimeScope = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local interactionButton = nil
local localActorId = nil
local hasLocalPassenger = false
local localActor = nil

local seatedActors = {}
local savedScale = {}
local savedPosition = {}
local savedRotation = {}
local savedColliderEnabled = {}

local flightScript = nil

local function getFlightScript()
  if flightScript ~= nil then return flightScript end
  if runtimeScope == nil then return nil end
  flightScript = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-flight.lua")
  return flightScript
end

local function notifyFlight(active)
  local flight = getFlightScript()
  if flight == nil or type(flight.SetRiderActive) ~= "function" then return end
  flight.SetRiderActive(active)
end

local function notifyOccupied(value)
  local flight = getFlightScript()
  if flight == nil or type(flight.SetOccupied) ~= "function" then return end
  flight.SetOccupied(value)
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then return end
  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(
    typeof(CS.UnityEngine.UI.Text), true)
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function ensureInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton == nil then
    interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  end
  setButtonText(hasLocalPassenger and "站起" or "坐下")
end

local function removeInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
    interactionButton = nil
  end
end

local function resolveSeatTrans()
  return self.transform
end

local function alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  target = target or resolveSeatTrans()
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil or target == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(target)
  trans.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  trans.localRotation = UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity

  local original = savedScale[actor] or UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  local parentScale = target.lossyScale
  trans.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    original.x / (parentScale.x ~= 0 and parentScale.x or 1),
    original.y / (parentScale.y ~= 0 and parentScale.y or 1),
    original.z / (parentScale.z ~= 0 and parentScale.z or 1)
  )

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(
    typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator == nil then return end

  local hips = animator:GetBoneTransform(CS.UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  if hips == nil then return end

  local hipsPosition = hips.position
  local actorPosition = trans.position
  trans.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    actorPosition.x - (hipsPosition.x - actorPosition.x),
    actorPosition.y - (hipsPosition.y - actorPosition.y),
    actorPosition.z - (hipsPosition.z - actorPosition.z)
  )
end

local function setActorColliderEnabled(actor, enabled)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local collider = actor.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Collider))
  if collider == nil then return end

  if not enabled then
    savedColliderEnabled[actor] = collider.enabled
    collider.enabled = false
  else
    local previous = savedColliderEnabled[actor]
    collider.enabled = previous == nil or previous
    savedColliderEnabled[actor] = nil
  end
end

local function placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(nil)

  if savedScale[actor] ~= nil then
    trans.localScale = savedScale[actor]
    savedScale[actor] = nil
  end

  local savedPos = savedPosition[actor]
  local savedRot = savedRotation[actor]
  if savedPos ~= nil and savedRot ~= nil then
    actor.position = savedPos
    actor.rotation = savedRot
  else
    local right = self.transform.right
    local base = self.transform.position
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      base.x + right.x * 1.2,
      base.y,
      base.z + right.z * 1.2
    )
    actor.rotation = self.transform.rotation
  end

  savedPosition[actor] = nil
  savedRotation[actor] = nil
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  localActorId = actor.actorID
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end

  -- 在座时保留 Actor ID 和交互通道，保证飞行中仍能站起。
  if not hasLocalPassenger then
    self:DisableInteraction()
    localActorId = nil
  end
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  ensureInteractionButton()
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActorId == nil then return end

  local actor = DouyinActorService.GetActorById(localActorId)
  if actor == nil then return end

  if hasLocalPassenger then
    actor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
  else
    if actor:IsFlying() or resolveSeatTrans() == nil then return end
    actor:SitDown(self.gameObject, true)
  end
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  local target = resolveSeatTrans()
  if target == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  savedPosition[actor] = trans.position
  savedRotation[actor] = trans.rotation
  savedScale[actor] = trans.localScale

  alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  seatedActors[actor] = target
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, false)
  notifyOccupied(true)

  if actor.isLocal then
    hasLocalPassenger = true
    localActor = actor
    if actor.Immobilize ~= nil then
      actor:Immobilize(true)
    end
    self:EnableInteraction()
    ensureInteractionButton()
    notifyFlight(true)
  end
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end

  -- 先停止持续对齐，再解除挂载，避免离座后又被拉回座位。
  seatedActors[actor] = nil
  if actor.gameObject == nil then
    notifyOccupied(false)
    if actor.isLocal then
      hasLocalPassenger = false
      localActor = nil
      notifyFlight(false)
    end
    return
  end
  placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
  notifyOccupied(false)

  if actor.isLocal then
    hasLocalPassenger = false
    if localActor == actor then
      localActor = nil
    end
    if actor.Immobilize ~= nil then
      actor:Immobilize(false)
    end
    setButtonText("坐下")
    notifyFlight(false)
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  for actor, target in pairs(seatedActors) do
    alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  end
end

local function cleanupLocalRider()
  if localActor ~= nil and localActor.Immobilize ~= nil then
    localActor:Immobilize(false)
  end
  localActor = nil
  hasLocalPassenger = false
  seatedActors = {}
  notifyOccupied(false)
  notifyFlight(false)
end

function OnDisable()
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnDestroy()
  removeInteractionButton()
  cleanupLocalRider()
end

---@name 触发范围倍率

---@group 交互
---@end

local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

display.text:
-- 黑龙鞍座：靠近触发、上下座按钮、骑手对齐与离座恢复
---@displayName 黑龙鞍座
---@start
---@var TriggerRangeScale:number=1
---@name 触发范围倍率
---@desc 基于初始触发范围等比放大
---@group 交互
---@end

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local RuntimeScope = require("official.core.runtime_scope")
local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local runtimeScope = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local interactionButton = nil
local localActorId = nil
local hasLocalPassenger = false
local localActor = nil

local seatedActors = {}
local savedScale = {}
local savedPosition = {}
local savedRotation = {}
local savedColliderEnabled = {}

local flightScript = nil

local function getFlightScript()
  if flightScript ~= nil then return flightScript end
  if runtimeScope == nil then return nil end
  flightScript = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-flight.lua")
  return flightScript
end

local function notifyFlight(active)
  local flight = getFlightScript()
  if flight == nil or type(flight.SetRiderActive) ~= "function" then return end
  flight.SetRiderActive(active)
end

local function notifyOccupied(value)
  local flight = getFlightScript()
  if flight == nil or type(flight.SetOccupied) ~= "function" then return end
  flight.SetOccupied(value)
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then return end
  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(
    typeof(CS.UnityEngine.UI.Text), true)
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function ensureInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton == nil then
    interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  end
  setButtonText(hasLocalPassenger and "站起" or "坐下")
end

local function removeInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
    interactionButton = nil
  end
end

local function resolveSeatTrans()
  return self.transform
end

local function alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  target = target or resolveSeatTrans()
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil or target == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(target)
  trans.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  trans.localRotation = UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity

  local original = savedScale[actor] or UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  local parentScale = target.lossyScale
  trans.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    original.x / (parentScale.x ~= 0 and parentScale.x or 1),
    original.y / (parentScale.y ~= 0 and parentScale.y or 1),
    original.z / (parentScale.z ~= 0 and parentScale.z or 1)
  )

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(
    typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator == nil then return end

  local hips = animator:GetBoneTransform(CS.UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  if hips == nil then return end

  local hipsPosition = hips.position
  local actorPosition = trans.position
  trans.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    actorPosition.x - (hipsPosition.x - actorPosition.x),
    actorPosition.y - (hipsPosition.y - actorPosition.y),
    actorPosition.z - (hipsPosition.z - actorPosition.z)
  )
end

local function setActorColliderEnabled(actor, enabled)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local collider = actor.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Collider))
  if collider == nil then return end

  if not enabled then
    savedColliderEnabled[actor] = collider.enabled
    collider.enabled = false
  else
    local previous = savedColliderEnabled[actor]
    collider.enabled = previous == nil or previous
    savedColliderEnabled[actor] = nil
  end
end

local function placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(nil)

  if savedScale[actor] ~= nil then
    trans.localScale = savedScale[actor]
    savedScale[actor] = nil
  end

  local savedPos = savedPosition[actor]
  local savedRot = savedRotation[actor]
  if savedPos ~= nil and savedRot ~= nil then
    actor.position = savedPos
    actor.rotation = savedRot
  else
    local right = self.transform.right
    local base = self.transform.position
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      base.x + right.x * 1.2,
      base.y,
      base.z + right.z * 1.2
    )
    actor.rotation = self.transform.rotation
  end

  savedPosition[actor] = nil
  savedRotation[actor] = nil
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  localActorId = actor.actorID
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end

  -- 在座时保留 Actor ID 和交互通道，保证飞行中仍能站起。
  if not hasLocalPassenger then
    self:DisableInteraction()
    localActorId = nil
  end
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  ensureInteractionButton()
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActorId == nil then return end

  local actor = DouyinActorService.GetActorById(localActorId)
  if actor == nil then return end

  if hasLocalPassenger then
    actor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
  else
    if actor:IsFlying() or resolveSeatTrans() == nil then return end
    actor:SitDown(self.gameObject, true)
  end
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  local target = resolveSeatTrans()
  if target == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  savedPosition[actor] = trans.position
  savedRotation[actor] = trans.rotation
  savedScale[actor] = trans.localScale

  alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  seatedActors[actor] = target
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, false)
  notifyOccupied(true)

  if actor.isLocal then
    hasLocalPassenger = true
    localActor = actor
    if actor.Immobilize ~= nil then
      actor:Immobilize(true)
    end
    self:EnableInteraction()
    ensureInteractionButton()
    notifyFlight(true)
  end
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end

  -- 先停止持续对齐，再解除挂载，避免离座后又被拉回座位。
  seatedActors[actor] = nil
  if actor.gameObject == nil then
    notifyOccupied(false)
    if actor.isLocal then
      hasLocalPassenger = false
      localActor = nil
      notifyFlight(false)
    end
    return
  end
  placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
  notifyOccupied(false)

  if actor.isLocal then
    hasLocalPassenger = false
    if localActor == actor then
      localActor = nil
    end
    if actor.Immobilize ~= nil then
      actor:Immobilize(false)
    end
    setButtonText("坐下")
    notifyFlight(false)
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  for actor, target in pairs(seatedActors) do
    alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  end
end

local function cleanupLocalRider()
  if localActor ~= nil and localActor.Immobilize ~= nil then
    localActor:Immobilize(false)
  end
  localActor = nil
  hasLocalPassenger = false
  seatedActors = {}
  notifyOccupied(false)
  notifyFlight(false)
end

function OnDisable()
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnDestroy()
  removeInteractionButton()
  cleanupLocalRider()
end

local Trigger = require("official.interaction.trigger")

local runtimeScope = RuntimeScope.from(self)
Trigger.applyRangeScale(self, TriggerRangeScale)

local interactionButton = nil
local localActorId = nil
local hasLocalPassenger = false
local localActor = nil

local seatedActors = {}
local savedScale = {}
local savedPosition = {}
local savedRotation = {}
local savedColliderEnabled = {}

local flightScript = nil

local function getFlightScript()
  if flightScript ~= nil then return flightScript end
  if runtimeScope == nil then return nil end
  flightScript = runtimeScope:GetScript("ms-flight.lua")
  return flightScript
end

local function notifyFlight(active)
  local flight = getFlightScript()
  if flight == nil or type(flight.SetRiderActive) ~= "function" then return end
  flight.SetRiderActive(active)
end

local function notifyOccupied(value)
  local flight = getFlightScript()
  if flight == nil or type(flight.SetOccupied) ~= "function" then return end
  flight.SetOccupied(value)
end

local function setButtonText(text)
  if interactionButton == nil then return end
  local label = interactionButton:GetComponentInChildren(
    typeof(CS.UnityEngine.UI.Text), true)
  if label ~= nil then
    label.text = text
  end
end

local function ensureInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton == nil then
    interactionButton = self:AddInteractorButton()
  end
  setButtonText(hasLocalPassenger and "站起" or "坐下")
end

local function removeInteractionButton()
  if interactionButton ~= nil then
    self:RemoveInteractorButton(interactionButton)
    interactionButton = nil
  end
end

local function resolveSeatTrans()
  return self.transform
end

local function alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  target = target or resolveSeatTrans()
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil or target == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(target)
  trans.localPosition = UnityEngine.Vector3.zero
  trans.localRotation = UnityEngine.Quaternion.identity

  local original = savedScale[actor] or UnityEngine.Vector3.one
  local parentScale = target.lossyScale
  trans.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    original.x / (parentScale.x ~= 0 and parentScale.x or 1),
    original.y / (parentScale.y ~= 0 and parentScale.y or 1),
    original.z / (parentScale.z ~= 0 and parentScale.z or 1)
  )

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(
    typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
  if animator == nil then return end

  local hips = animator:GetBoneTransform(CS.UnityEngine.HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  if hips == nil then return end

  local hipsPosition = hips.position
  local actorPosition = trans.position
  trans.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
    actorPosition.x - (hipsPosition.x - actorPosition.x),
    actorPosition.y - (hipsPosition.y - actorPosition.y),
    actorPosition.z - (hipsPosition.z - actorPosition.z)
  )
end

local function setActorColliderEnabled(actor, enabled)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end
  local collider = actor.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Collider))
  if collider == nil then return end

  if not enabled then
    savedColliderEnabled[actor] = collider.enabled
    collider.enabled = false
  else
    local previous = savedColliderEnabled[actor]
    collider.enabled = previous == nil or previous
    savedColliderEnabled[actor] = nil
  end
end

local function placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  trans:SetParent(nil)

  if savedScale[actor] ~= nil then
    trans.localScale = savedScale[actor]
    savedScale[actor] = nil
  end

  local savedPos = savedPosition[actor]
  local savedRot = savedRotation[actor]
  if savedPos ~= nil and savedRot ~= nil then
    actor.position = savedPos
    actor.rotation = savedRot
  else
    local right = self.transform.right
    local base = self.transform.position
    actor.position = UnityEngine.Vector3(
      base.x + right.x * 1.2,
      base.y,
      base.z + right.z * 1.2
    )
    actor.rotation = self.transform.rotation
  end

  savedPosition[actor] = nil
  savedRotation[actor] = nil
end

function OnActorTriggerEnter(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end
  localActorId = actor.actorID
  self:EnableInteraction()
end

function OnActorTriggerExit(actor)
  if actor == nil or not actor.isLocal then return end

  -- 在座时保留 Actor ID 和交互通道，保证飞行中仍能站起。
  if not hasLocalPassenger then
    self:DisableInteraction()
    localActorId = nil
  end
end

function OnFocus(handType)
  ensureInteractionButton()
end

function OnLostFocus(handType)
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)
  if index ~= 1 or localActorId == nil then return end

  local actor = DouyinActorService.GetActorById(localActorId)
  if actor == nil then return end

  if hasLocalPassenger then
    actor:StandUp(self.gameObject)
  else
    if actor:IsFlying() or resolveSeatTrans() == nil then return end
    actor:SitDown(self.gameObject, true)
  end
end

function OnSeatEntered(actor, handType)
  if actor == nil or actor.gameObject == nil then return end

  local target = resolveSeatTrans()
  if target == nil then return end

  local trans = actor.gameObject.transform
  savedPosition[actor] = trans.position
  savedRotation[actor] = trans.rotation
  savedScale[actor] = trans.localScale

  alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  seatedActors[actor] = target
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, false)
  notifyOccupied(true)

  if actor.isLocal then
    hasLocalPassenger = true
    localActor = actor
    if actor.Immobilize ~= nil then
      actor:Immobilize(true)
    end
    self:EnableInteraction()
    ensureInteractionButton()
    notifyFlight(true)
  end
end

function OnSeatExited(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end

  -- 先停止持续对齐，再解除挂载，避免离座后又被拉回座位。
  seatedActors[actor] = nil
  if actor.gameObject == nil then
    notifyOccupied(false)
    if actor.isLocal then
      hasLocalPassenger = false
      localActor = nil
      notifyFlight(false)
    end
    return
  end
  placeActorAtStandPoint(actor)
  setActorColliderEnabled(actor, true)
  notifyOccupied(false)

  if actor.isLocal then
    hasLocalPassenger = false
    if localActor == actor then
      localActor = nil
    end
    if actor.Immobilize ~= nil then
      actor:Immobilize(false)
    end
    setButtonText("坐下")
    notifyFlight(false)
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  for actor, target in pairs(seatedActors) do
    alignActorHipsToSeat(actor, target)
  end
end

local function cleanupLocalRider()
  if localActor ~= nil and localActor.Immobilize ~= nil then
    localActor:Immobilize(false)
  end
  localActor = nil
  hasLocalPassenger = false
  seatedActors = {}
  notifyOccupied(false)
  notifyFlight(false)
end

function OnDisable()
  removeInteractionButton()
end

function OnDestroy()
  removeInteractionButton()
  cleanupLocalRider()
end
